notes.title: New camera and movement systems
notes.content:
Hello again!

I'm working on a new camera system similar to RTS. Second thing - I'm back to Point & Click. There is also a new Alyssa model. This needed to be updated because the previous character movement and camera limited the player's capabilities. I'm disappointed that I wasn't able to release the Alyssa demo at the Steam Festival. I hope to be able to deliver a demo to the Festival in June. It failed mainly due to problems with Alyssa's unpleasant controls and camera - I don't want to give you, the players, something that is not intuitive and not fun :)
​

Here you Can see how new Alyssa model look like and how "RTS" camera works (test scene):

[previewyoutube=qHcfG25dXaw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Demo - Coming Soon! (UPDATE)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694813/f45d3015db699d949a3e6a041e6d07213a3bc7ce.png[/img]

I am currently working on a demo version of ALYSSA! What I want to do in the demo is to present a Tutorial level that will teach the basics of gameplay, and then give you two levels that you can explore using Alyssa's abilities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694813/a73aa6433bcef33b2ed125d5c6a7a724420acfb2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694813/6baec4ccc4c6ac82063ada385d90d024b89636c3.png[/img]

You will be able to make your first murders, discover your first secrets and... Use demons to help Alyssa!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44694813/f29e616d14b316e40e54255693057e2acb4ff821.png[/img]

[strike]The ALYSSA demo is sure to appear at the Steam Next Festival in February 2024! If successful, it will appear even before the festival![/strike]

UPDATE!

Unfortunately, I won't be able to bring the demo to the festival. Alyssa is a hobby project, created after work, so the lack of time, especially during the holidays, greatly hindered the continuation of work. The demo will appear, but a little later. Stay tuned for more announcements!

Thanks for being there!

Marcin from Broken Arrow Games
​
